intro: Across 32 articles dated 2026-04-12 to 2026-10-06, ZCyberNews coverage of critical infrastructure tracks APT33, CL-STA-1062, and CL-STA-1178. CVE-2026-24032, rated CVSS 7.3, is the most frequently cited vulnerability. Affected sectors include energy, critical infrastructure, government, critical-infrastructure, and utilities, while activity spans the United states, Global, North america, Europe, and the Middle east. The severity mix comprises 15 high, 3 critical, 3 informational, and 1 medium.
